_comment: Production Configuration for ConstantV Native Core Simulation
_warning: This is a TEMPLATE. You MUST update atom indices to match your PDB structure!

cathode._comment_indices: Auto-identified from residue name 'CAT'. No manual indices needed.

anode._comment_indices: Auto-identified from residue name 'ANO'. No manual indices needed.

conductors._note: If your system has no conductors, set this to an empty array: []

buckyballs._comment: Chain 2 = virtual layer, Chain 3 = real layer
buckyballs._comment_voltage: FIXED: Changed from 1.0 to 2.0 V to match system voltage. Conductors should be at same potential as electrode they're attached to.

conductors._note_nanotubes: ✅ Nanotube implementation is now COMPLETE. Full two-step algorithm: (1) surface polarization + (2) charge transfer. Ready for production use after recompilation.

simulation_parameters._comment_friction: FIXED: Changed drude_friction from 20.0 to 1.0 (matching original MM_classes.py:89)
simulation_parameters._comment_Lgap: Lgap = vacuum gap to periodic image; Lcell = distance between electrodes. Verify Lgap is correct for your geometry.
simulation_parameters._comment_scf: FIXED: Changed scf_frequency from 1 to 200 (matching original freq_charge_update_fs=200). SCF runs every 200 steps (200 fs with 1 fs timestep).
simulation_parameters._comment_area: Electrode area computed automatically from atom counts

run_parameters._comment_platform: Options: CUDA, OpenCL, CPU, Reference. CUDA recommended for production.

advanced._comment: Residues with < natom_cutoff atoms are classified as electrolyte
advanced._comment_water: Set hybrid_water_model=true if using mixed water/SAPT-FF force field (e.g., TIP4P-FB + SAPT-FF). This creates interaction groups for correct water-water vs. water-other interactions.
